notes.title: UI Overhaul
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added a new chainsaw skin - red chainsaw![/p][/*][*][p]Completely changed the spinner screen with a bigger spinner, light up lettering and a preview of the potential skins you can unlock.[/p][/*][*][p]Completely changed the inventory screen making it easier to choose skins and displaying your currently selected skins.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the look of the buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a challenges button - coming soon![/p][/*][*][p]Other behind the scenes improvements to speed up load times and simplify processes.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the legendary chainsaw skin so all chainsaws now use the improved sprite.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: General improvements
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added lights to the spinner.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller and mouse functionality making it possible to switch between them at any point.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved other chainsaw sprites.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more chainsaws.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update 1
notes.content: [list][*][p]Made each button scale up when the mouse enters and scale down again when it exits.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the sprites for two chainsaw skins and the back button.[/p][/*][*][p]Animated the spinner button.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the mouse disappear during gameplay and reappear when paused or after game over.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to go back using escape key or back button on controller instead of navigating to the back button in the corner.[/p][/*][*][p]Resized the images in the background subsection of the inventory to decrease load time when opening the inventory.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]
